# SaralPrivacy — DPDPA Compliance Platform for Indian Businesses

## What is SaralPrivacy?
SaralPrivacy (saralprivacy.com) is India's practical DPDPA (Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023) compliance education platform. We provide free readiness assessments, daily briefings, industry-specific guides, and expert consultation to help Indian businesses comply with India's data protection law.

## Who is this for?
- Recruitment agencies managing candidate CVs and personal data
- CA firms handling client PAN, Aadhaar, and financial records
- Training institutes collecting student and parent data
- D2C brands running WhatsApp, SMS, and email marketing campaigns

## Key Facts About DPDPA
- Full name: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
- Passed by Indian Parliament on 11 August 2023
- Rules (DPDP Rules) are expected to be notified by the Government of India
- Enforcement date: To be notified by the Government after rules are finalised
- Regulator: Data Protection Board of India (to be constituted)
- Penalties: Up to ₹250 crore per breach
- Applies to: Any entity processing personal data of Indian residents digitally
